emergencyNeeds.trauma: major injury care (surgery, CT and ICU)

emergencyHelp: Do not delay emergency care to search for a hospital. Let emergency services coordinate where to go.
emergencyMatching: Only hospital ERs with all published requirements are shown: {needs}.
emergencyGeneral: No specific treatment requirements were identified. These are published 24/7 ER facilities, not confirmed condition-specific matches.
emergencyAvailability: Published capabilities do not confirm available staff, beds or equipment today. Confirm with emergency services before travelling.
emergencyUnranked: Share your location to sort matching hospitals by distance. Without it, results are alphabetical.
emergencyNearest: Closest listed match by straight-line distance; not travel time. Confirm availability with emergency services.
emergencyNoMatch: No hospital with all required published capabilities matches these filters. Call 140 for a suitable destination; do not delay care or assume an unequipped hospital can treat the condition.
title: Find care
favoritesHint: Saved providers belong to your account, including when you are acting for a family member.
favoritesError: We couldn't load your saved providers.
favoriteError: We couldn't update your saved providers. Please try again.
favoriteLimit: You can save up to 100 providers. Remove one before adding another.
mapNotice: The map shows results on this page with a sourced location. Listings without verified coordinates remain in the list. A number on a marker shows facilities sharing that location. Select a marker for details. Map tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap.
mapError: The map could not fully load. Provider details are still available in the list below.
lead: Find hospitals and clinics in Lebanon, and keep useful places close at hand.
notice: This directory includes published MoPH hospital listings. A listing is not confirmation that a facility is currently operating. Call to confirm services, appointments and hours before travelling.
search: Search by hospital or clinic name
hoursNote: Hours are a schedule, not live availability. Holidays and service interruptions may differ. An open ER does not mean outpatient clinics are open.
locationHint: Optional: share your location with Nabad for this search. It is not saved to your account. Distance searches include only facilities with sourced coordinates. Distances are straight-line estimates, not road distances.
locationError: We couldn't get your location. You can still choose a city.
locationReady: Your location is ready. Search to apply it.
approximatePin: Approximate campus location; confirm the entrance before visiting.
loadError: We couldn't load providers. Please try again.
publicHint: Browse without an account. Sign in to save providers, leave feedback or report incorrect information.
servicesUnknown: Services and equipment not yet verified
servicesNote: Listed capabilities are published information, not a guarantee of live availability. Unlisted services may be available; call to confirm.
districtHint: A district includes nearby towns. Choose All cities to search the whole district; selected filters are combined.
locationUnknown: Map location not yet verified. Directions are unavailable for this listing.
insuranceNote: Published participation does not guarantee your policy covers a visit. Confirm your plan, approvals and out-of-pocket costs with the facility and insurer.

waiting.unknown: Waiting level: not enough recent reports

waitingUpdated: Based on {count} reports in the past two hours. Latest: {date} (Beirut time).
waitingNote: Waiting levels need at least three recent account reports and may change quickly. They are not a live queue or a prediction of your wait. Emergency care is prioritized by clinical urgency; do not delay care based on these reports.
